title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
slides: Can Meta's Muse agent actually replace your team?
Spaces is a shared workspace built for collaboration
But early tests show it struggles with conflicting input
Teams using it now report shorter iteration cycles
Try one real task in Spaces before your rival does
thread_text:
1. Meta's Muse: Team Replacement?

Meta's new AI agent Muse promises to overhaul team workflows, but early adopters are skeptical. Here's what we know so far.

2. Spaces: Built for Collaboration

Muse operates within Spaces, a shared workspace designed for real-time teamwork. It aims to streamline tasks and boost productivity.

3. Early Tests Reveal Struggles

Despite the hype, initial trials show Muse faltering with conflicting instructions. Users report confusion when inputs clash.

4. Shorter Iteration Cycles Reported

Teams already using Muse in Spaces say they're iterating faster than before. The collaborative environment seems to cut down back-and-forth.

5. Test Before Your Rival Does

Pick one real task and run it in Spaces this week. If you don't, a competitor might beat you to the insight.
